nodes.description: First project materialization point for the over-read target. While loading the attacker-selected `\005SummaryInformation` user stream, this loop copies the PoC's sector bytes into heap buffer `scn->sst_tab`, which is later parsed into the `s_buf` slice that `%s` overruns.

nodes.description: Root cause and sink. The debug print treats `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` as raw `%s` instead of a length-delimited `l`-byte slice, so the earlier `o4 + l <= left` check does not stop `printf` from scanning past the end of `sst_tab` when no NUL appears first.

AddressSanitizer sink. `printf` expands this `%s` argument and reads past the 8704-byte SummaryInformation heap buffer because the slice beginning at `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` is not NUL-terminated before the buffer end.

nodes.state: After the existing guard admits property 5, the parser stores the accepted slice in `inp[i].pi_str.s_len` and `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf`, with `o4 + l` still within the remaining property window `left`.
